_comment: Shared test vectors for search relevance ranking. Canonical implementation: ramekin-core/src/search.rs; iOS mirror: ramekin-ios/Ramekin/RecipeSearchSupport.swift. Consumed by ramekin-core/tests/search_ranking_tests.rs and SearchRankingSharedVectorTests. expected_order lists recipe ids from highest to lowest score and requires strictly decreasing scores (no ties); zero_score lists ids that must score exactly 0.

cases.name: exact title beats title phrase beats body-only match
accent-insensitive: plain ascii query finds accented title
accented query finds accented title identically
quoted phrase is one token; word order matters for the phrase bonus
single token: title beats tag beats description beats ingredient
notes-only match scores lowest but nonzero
ligature expansion: ascii query gets the exact-title score on a ligature title
ligature query normalizes identically to its ascii form
presentation ligature: ascii query scores a field whose only match uses U+FB01
measurement text scores: ingredients include amounts and units
empty token list scores everything zero
